Bug_Details:
Log tag too long, cannot exceed 23 characters. Log.isLoggable(tag, level) throws an IllegalArgumentException if its tag
argument is more than 23 characters long.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is demonstrated by using a log tag longer than 23 characters. In the showBug method, the logger.isLoggable method is called with a tag parameter that exceeds the 23 character limit, causing an IllegalArgumentException to be thrown.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case 'testShowBugWithLongTag' triggers the bug by passing a log tag longer than 23 characters to the 'showBug' method, causing an IllegalArgumentException due to the excessive length of the log tag.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results show that the test completed successfully with an 'OK' status, indicating that no exception was thrown and the bug was not triggered despite the long tag.
